scene: Playroom rug. Child and Peer sit cross-legged facing each other, Child at screen-right and Peer at screen-left, both with empty hands. The dragon and the treasure are imaginary and never shown as props. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot at floor level.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: A mild friendly debate stays warm; both use small hand shapes for the imaginary dragon; the ending is a shared laugh.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Child and Peer sit cross-legged facing each other with empty hands.
clips.action: Peer raises claw hands for the scary dragon. Child holds one palm out gently while saying he likes the idea but feels worried; Peer shrugs with open hands while asking again.
clips.end: Both sit with relaxed hands, thinking.

clips.start: Both sit with relaxed hands, thinking.
clips.action: Child pinches a tiny gap between finger and thumb for a tiny bit scary, then opens his arms wide for mostly friendly. Peer crosses his arms doubting a friendly guard; Child wraps his own arms around himself in one big gentle self-hug.
clips.end: Peer's crossed arms loosen into curiosity.

clips.start: Peer's crossed arms loosen into curiosity.
clips.action: Peer laughs once softly and mimes his own small hug. Child holds up one finger for his treasure logic while wearing a clever smile; both giggle gently and bump fists once.
clips.end: Both sit facing each other with happy relaxed faces and empty hands.
